verdicts.title: Mod 2 cohomology of 2-local finite groups of low rank
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We determine the mod $2$ cohomology over the Steenrod algebra of the classifying spaces of the free loop groups $LG$ for compact groups $G=Spin(7)$, $Spin(8)$, $Spin(9)$, and $F_4$.
